one_liner_ko: 사용자의 서버에서 동작하며 요청한 일을 해 주는 오픈소스 개인 AI 비서.
what_it_does_ko: Leon은 사용자의 서버에 설치해 쓰는 오픈소스 개인 비서로, 말이나 글로 대화하며 요청한 일을 처리한다. 스킬(패키지·모듈) 구조라 필요한 기능을 직접 만들거나 가져다 쓸 수 있다. 음성 합성(TTS)·음성 인식(STT)을 클라우드나 오프라인 방식으로 쓸 수 있어 외부 서비스 없이도 동작하게 설정할 수 있다. 현재 2.0 개발자 프리뷰에서는 도구·컨텍스트·메모리·에이전트 실행 중심으로 다시 만들어지고 있다.
key_features: 데스크톱·브라우저 화면을 조작하는 컴퓨터 사용 기능
use_cases_ko: 개인이 자기 서버에 비서를 두고 일상 디지털 작업 자동화
개발자가 자기 필요에 맞는 스킬을 만들어 공유

evidence.quote:
Leon is your open-source personal assistant who can live on your server.
He does stuff when you ask him to.

You can talk to him and he can talk to you.
You can also text him and he can also text you.

Leon supports several text-to-speech and speech-to-text cloud solutions.
Or you can also go for the offline ones.
**Leon** is **your open-source personal AI assistant** built around **tools, context, memory, and agentic execution**.
Leon is built on a modular architecture that gives you the flexibility to create or use packages/modules (skills) that fit your need.
`smart` mode chooses for you, `controlled` mode follows deterministic native skills and actions, and `agent` mode can plan step by step.
Leon includes advanced, progressively loaded computer use that can operate desktop and browser interfaces
Leon keeps layered memory so it can remember durable preferences, day-to-day context, and recent discussion context.
Leon supports both local and remote AI providers, which helps balance privacy, control, and capability.
Remove the hassle of your virtual life by automating stuff. You can think of Leon as your virtual brain.
With this generic structure, everyone can create their own modules and share them .
If you already benefit from Leon, or you'd love to see the upcoming features happening faster, please consider to sponsor the project.
Under MIT license which is the most permissive license in the open-source world

Packages & Modules 
 HTTP API 
 Collaborative Logger
The Leon CLI is the companion that will help with your journey by making the setup very smooth and more!
